description: This file contains action creators for inviting members and guests to channels and teams in Mattermost, including handling email invites, guest invites, and related responses.

methods.name: sendMembersInvites
methods.description: Sends invites to members via team ID, user profiles, and emails, handling guest checks, existing membership, and email invite responses.

methods.name: sendGuestInviteForUser
methods.description: Invites a guest user to a team and channels, adding them if not already a member, and handling errors.

methods.name: sendGuestsInvites
methods.description: Sends invites to guest users and via email to channels, managing responses and errors.

methods.name: sendMembersInvitesToChannels
methods.description: Sends member invites to channels and team, including email invites, with handling for existing members and errors.
